elements.text:
You post a photo of a tasty dish that you've made on Instagram. 
After an hour one of your followers responds ‘What dish is that? What is meant by this response? 

 
I've clearly made a mess of the dish because it isn't recognizable.  

On a scale of 1-5, how likely is this thought to pop into your mind?

buttons: 1::1: Doesn't pop up in my mind;2::2;3::3: Might pop up in my mind;4::4;5::5: Definitely pops up in my mind;
